description: Curated rows for tools/unified_bench_matrix.py: measurements that exist only in record prose or tables (verbatim numbers, each citing its record file and section), prose cross-checks of parsed rows (same key as a parsed row; the parsed row wins and the ratios are compared), and annotations that attach the record's explanation or follow-up to parsed rows.
notes: Records with no paired measurement: 0249 ('No performance measurement is claimed'), 0251 ('No performance claim: this step changes no measured hot path'), 0257 ('No hot path changed, so no performance measurement applies'), 0265 (§7: 'nothing was measured against them'; harness duration only), 0272 (route-identity check only, 'no timing claim'). Record 0263 has only prose before/after ratios (curated).
Records 0285–0288 do not exist on this base (feat/unified-ops-api at 9fe45629ab); nothing to collect.
Records 0250, 0263 and 0268 compare builds (after/before), not unified with leaf; they are included with comparison 'after/before'. Record 0268's rows are leaf-only ODF timings with no budget.

Earlier states re-measured as 'before' legs of later records (0262, 0267, 0275 tiny-input base, 0280 base) are not repeated: the earlier record's own row carries that state. Exceptions with their own rows: 0258 trunk and pre-fix legs, 0259 read-before, 0260 before, 0264 scaling, 0281 before (its §3 table).

0281's committed evidence is one run per harness; its §3 ratio ranges (e.g. 1.085–1.097) include runs that were not committed, so the cross-checks below show the parsed single value against the prose range.
0264's 16384-bound experiment in 0264-ppt-scale.json (uncommitted build) is not listed; the applied bound is measured in 0264-ppt-bound.json.

annotations.explanation: Record 0280 §4.1/§6 G1–G2: after the lock-free fstat check (≈125 ns floor) the remaining cost is the owned node itself (one Arc per match, moves of the 184-byte unified node) and the walker's step; the per-match file check is kept by owner decision 2026-10-14 (G1). Against the fair leaves: file-backed full queries 1.17–1.36× the fenced leaf, memory scans 4.4–4.8× the owned leaf. Handed to R6 (PROGRESS Wave R5).

Record 0280 §4.1/§6 G1–G2: after the lock-free fstat check (≈125 ns floor) the remaining cost is the owned node itself (one Arc per match, moves of the 184-byte unified node) and the walker's step; the per-match file check is kept by owner decision 2026-10-14 (G1). Against the fair leaves: file-backed full queries 1.17–1.36× the fenced leaf, memory scans 4.4–4.8× the owned leaf. Handed to R6 (PROGRESS Wave R5). XLSB has no fair (owned/fenced) baseline route; record 0267 §4.2: XLSB full scans gained from the small node (43× → 15× from memory).

Record 0280 §4.1/§6 G2, G4: full queries 26–83% faster (master/layout cache); remaining are the owned-node cost (2.2–2.5× the fair owned leaf on 500 slides; 0.30× on 10 slides) and strict_scene's Arc clone per shape on each slide read (G4: a borrowed iterator in litchi-pptx). File-backed vs the fenced leaf: 1.30–1.36×. Handed to R6.

Not addressed by 0280 ('DOCX … unchanged within noise'); record 0262 §3: 'DOCX is unchanged within noise (1.07–1.6×; its adapter was not touched, agent p7a owns it)'; 0262 F4: the DOCX node is the largest generic node (176 bytes). No DOCX query follow-up is scheduled.

Record 0280 §4.2: the walker now skips nodes with no wanted children (≈6× → 3.7–3.9× the fair leaf); record 0276 §6: the remaining ≈0.18 µs per match is node construction, compiled-plan dispatch and per-match paths. 0276 states no numeric query budget; PROGRESS R5 does not list ODT query as open.

Record 0280 §4.3 / §6 G3: unchanged; the fair pairings show 35–41×, about 70% of it in the ODS adapter (eager A1 labels per cell and its child iterator) in format/ods, outside 0280's files. Follow-up G3, handed to R6.

Record 0280 §4.4 / §6 G5: unchanged single-target edit-closure set (1.11–1.14×) and fan-out (1.32–1.50×): compiling a plan, the walk and the transaction frame cost a fixed ≈0.3–1.4 µs that one ~5 µs native edit does not amortize. Next steps: a compiled-plan cache keyed by the selector text and a lighter one-command edit path.

Record 0281 §4.1 / F1: ≈15.5 K extra instructions per call (9.6 K path resolution, of which OpcPackage::main_document_part re-normalizing the officeDocument target is 4.4 K; ≈6 K wrapping the native commit into File/Commit). Needs the main-part name memoized per OPC graph in litchi-opc or a per-handle body index. Record 0280 G6: the remaining cost is in the DOCX adapter (format/docx/write.rs), not transaction.rs.

Record 0281 §4.2 / F2: adoption of the source graph into an eager package re-inflates every member and re-reads every relationship member (1.4 M instructions); needs a source-backed PPTX metadata edit (0262 F3: a part overlay in litchi_pptx::source::Package) or reuse of the open catalog's relationship payloads in litchi-opc.

Record 0281 §4.3 / F3: per eager get ≈2.7 K extra instructions (1.6 K shared path resolver and vocabulary, 0.7 K XLS Nav::child, 0.4 K View::text); on positional owners Xls::check_source runs ≈4× per get or scanned cell (fstat each). Fences, step parsing and the walker belong to the shared layer (0280). Record 0280 G1: the per-match check is kept by owner decision; the leaf-side probes in litchi-cfb/litchi-xls could be skipped inside the ops fence scope.

Record 0259 'Write overhead': 'Row and column writes on a positional owner miss by about 10%. Resolving the row[N]/col[X] target through the generic resolver projects the sheet's axis layout from the source. This costs about 600 µs at 10k cells and is part of the same resolver follow-up.' Not re-measured since.

Record 0275 'Tiny-input overhead': 'the layout path improves but stays a miss (1.14–1.16): the remaining unified cost is coercing nine string-valued properties and the paragraph-property scan, which the native leg receives pre-typed.' Not re-measured by 0280.

Record 0275 'Tiny-input overhead': 'Single-target query fan-out (1.45×) … unchanged misses: query planning and the transaction coordinator cost a fixed few hundred nanoseconds that one target cannot amortize' — follow-up in the shared query and transaction layers; record 0280 G5 (compiled-plan cache, lighter one-command edit path).

Record 0275 'Tiny-input overhead': 'single sets inside an edit closure (1.08–1.30×) are unchanged misses: query planning and the transaction coordinator cost a fixed few hundred nanoseconds that one target cannot amortize'; record 0280 G5 (RTF single-target fixed costs, open).

Not discussed by record 0275 (its table covers 0–1 groups; 'All other cases with at least ten targets are within their budgets'). Flagged by 0289: one of the two processes measured 1.124 and the other 1.019, and that process's native median was also 19% slower (35.6 vs 30.0 ms), which points to host noise; re-measure before acting.

Record 0283 §4/§5: the unified call resolves /Sheet1/chart[1], which reads the worksheet drawing's chart inventory once more than the native edit; a 100-anchor inventory costs ≈240 µs. Follow-up: memoize the drawing's chart inventory per worksheet snapshot in litchi-xlsx (shared by resolution, Edit::chart and Edit::set), or a faster inventory scan.

0251a: ≈36 µs of the 39 µs overhead is read-side path resolution of tr[R]/tc[C] (Table::rows over the whole table and the cell's block index); follow-up: a row/cell seek or per-generation table cache.

0251f Item 8: unified-only path resolution against the body index (≈0.9 µs of 10.1 µs), mostly Package::document() → main_document_part → PackURI::from_rel_ref; candidate fixes: memoize the main part name in litchi-opc, or a body index per immutable Docx handle.

0252 §5: the unified path resolves /slide/shape/paragraph/run by reading the eager slide's shape scene and text body, which the eager owner does not cache; follow-up: an eager scene cache (plan step 8) or a resolve-free positional path.

0253 §7/§8 F2: the source-backed rows include the unified owner's promotion (PPTX adopts the source graph into an eager package; XLSB materializes its workbook); a leaf source-backed metadata edit would remove it.

0253 §7/§8 F2: XLSB source-backed sets materialize the workbook first. Fixed by record 0261 §2 (source-backed metadata on the leaf; its own harness xlsb_metadata_source_bench: unified-source / leaf-source 1.018–1.036).

0262's after binary predates the 0261 merge (record 0262 §3 measures branch uo2/p8-perf); record 0261 §2 closed this miss (unified-source / leaf-source 1.018–1.036 in xlsb_metadata_source_bench); 0281 re-measured 0.639 here.
0269 §7 P1: the unified add reads the slide scene for the direct-shape ordinal and adopts the new owner; the leaf leg does neither.
0269 §6 / P2: a Warn batch does not coalesce (≈176 µs per item, own snapshot per item); follow-up: pre-admit each item's properties against the registry so atomic warn batches keep the native runs.
0273 §5: misses by 2.8 points at one match; the rest is the general matcher and planner per paragraph against the leaf's str::contains; follow-up: a leaf-level prefilter over the paragraph bytes.
0275: picture removal is capped at 64 per native transaction and removal was not coalesced (each direct remove publishes separately); 0280 coalesces direct picture removals.
0260: one excess whole-slide parse (unified resolved the target through one slide handle, then the native edit reparsed the same bytes); fixed in 0260 by a one-slide shape memo.
